desc: Implement cost precomputation: for each target value t, compute array of (cost = (t - n % t) % t, n) for all nums.
Keep only the top K smallest-cost candidates per target (K = 60) to bound search space.
Perform backtracking/combinatorial search over targets (≤4), selecting one distinct nums per target from its candidate list, accumulating cost.
Add pruning: skip branches where partial cost already exceeds current best; ensure used indices are distinct.
Return the minimum total cost found as the answer.
Write final code with `from typing import List` and test on provided examples (1, 2, 3) and random small cases.
